item: Row J J1: the feed-key backfill is one transaction, so the boot step takes 0.25 s instead of 11 s on an encrypted store
refs: R145; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: backfill_feed_keys set each row's feed key with its own UPDATE on the boot path's autocommit connection, one commit per source: 11.0 s encrypted and 1.59 s plaintext for the 6,400 shipped sources at 2 M articles, at 10 M articles the same. It now runs them in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE...COMMIT when the connection has no transaction open (0.245 s and 0.21 s measured), begins and commits nothing for a caller with a transaction open, and rolls the whole batch back on a failure. The rebuild itself never touches the articles table.
